name: vwap_mean_reversion_v5
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when India VIX exceeds 15, market maker quote widening and elevated institutional hedging urgency amplify intraday moves — even moderate-volume directional selling (1.2x the 4-minute baseline, not panic levels) can drive NIFTY 80-100 spot points below session VWAP within minutes, creating a z-score below -2.7 on the 20-minute rolling standard deviation. In elevated-VIX regimes, VWAP-benchmarked buy-side algorithms increase their accumulation urgency threshold precisely because the cost of underperforming their benchmark compounds faster when volatility is high — they step in aggressively once deviation reaches the 2.7-sigma level to ensure VWAP-or-better fills before further vol expansion makes it impossible. This differs from low-VIX VWAP reversion (v1, v18) where deviations are shallower and slower, and from panic capitulation (v3) where 1.7x volume is required regardless of VIX regime — here the VIX filter does the selectivity work, allowing a lower volume bar (1.2x) to be the confirmation trigger.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP is cumulative — no lookback scaling applies. This is the institutional benchmark price that buy-side algorithms must beat. In elevated-VIX regimes the deviation from VWAP has amplified urgency because benchmark slippage compounds with rising vol.

indicators.name: vwap_stddev_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute (240 bar) rolling std of close prices, used as the z-score denominator. Chosen at 240 bars (not 12x original's 14 × 15min = 168 1-min = 2,016 5s bars — that would be a 2.8-hour context, way too long). We need the CURRENT session's volatility regime, not multi-hour history. 20 min (240 bars) gives a statistically stable denominator that is responsive to intraday vol regime shifts. Slightly shorter than v3's 360-bar (30 min) stddev to be more responsive in the high-VIX environments this strategy specifically targets.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Measures VWAP deviation in units of 20-minute realized volatility. At z = -2.7 in a typical intraday session with 20-min std ~30 pts, this represents ~80 spot points below VWAP. In elevated VIX regimes (>15), the std is larger, so z=-2.7 corresponds to even larger absolute deviations — making the signal rarer and the subsequent snap-back more violent.

indicators.name: rel_volume_48
indicators.purpose: 4-minute (48 bar) relative volume baseline. Original used SMA(volume, 30) on 15-min bars = 450-min lookback (multi-session history). We cannot use multi-session history at 5s — vol is non-stationary across days. 4 min (48 bars) captures the current intraday participation rate without bias from pre-market or prior sessions. Longer than v3's 24-bar (2 min) baseline because this strategy has a LOWER signal threshold (1.2x vs 1.7x for v3), requiring a smoother average to prevent noisy volume spikes from triggering false signals.

indicators.name: vix_close
indicators.formula: India VIX close, aligned backward via asof join to spot bars
indicators.purpose: Regime gate: VIX > 15 is the primary differentiator of this strategy. In calm markets (VIX < 15), VWAP deviations at z=-2.7 are rarer and the snap-back is slower because hedging urgency is low. VIX > 15 selects the sessions where institutional VWAP-benchmark urgency is structurally elevated, making 2.7-sigma deviations predictably short-lived. Same threshold as original (VIX > 15) because VIX levels carry structural meaning independent of bar frequency.

conditions: at least 240 bars of warmup (first 20 min excluded)
buy_ce.confirmation: VIX regime filter is the primary quality gate; volume confirmation at 1.2x prevents entries on thin-volume micro-drifts. No multi-bar persistence needed because z=-2.7 in elevated VIX is itself a high-conviction signal.

buy_pe.confirmation: Symmetric: elevated VIX + extreme VWAP overshoot above + moderate volume confirms short-side over-extension.

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts (~10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). In VIX > 15 regimes, NIFTY can move 5-10 spot pts per 5-second bar during volatile patches. A further 10 spot pt decline after entry (beyond the 80-100 pt deviation already in place) signals structural breakdown rather than overshoot — the VWAP-benchmarked institutional accumulation has not materialized. Tighter than v3's 7 pts despite the same z-score threshold because the VIX filter means we're specifically in regimes where reversion is faster and sharper; a slow further decline invalidates the high-VIX urgency thesis quickly.
exit.target_rationale: 9 option pts (~18 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). In VIX > 15 environments with z=-2.7 entry, the first-leg snap-back covers 20-30 spot pts in 30-90 seconds as urgent VWAP-benchmarked buyers absorb available supply. 9 pts captures ~60-70% of the typical 25-30pt first leg (conservative to avoid overstaying). Compared to v3's 12-pt target: v3 targets rarer but more extreme panic events (requiring 1.7x volume); v5 targets the more frequent elevated-VIX class (1.2x volume) where reversion is reliable but the first leg is smaller. R:R = 1:1.8.

filters.vix_filter: vix_close > 15.0 — core regime gate; in calm VIX (<15) environments VWAP deviations at 2.7-sigma are too slow to revert within 120s
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST; first 15 minutes excluded to let VWAP and 20-min rolling std stabilize
filters.volume_filter: rel_volume_48 > 1.2 — moderate surge to distinguish directional flow from tick noise at 5s resolution
filters.trend_filter: none — strategy fades extreme deviation, trend alignment would contradict the reversion thesis
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — structural VWAP benchmarking urgency in elevated-VIX regimes is persistent; risk is that SEBI circuit breakers reduce extreme intraday swings over time, compressing the 2.7-sigma event frequency

adaptation_notes: Original Strategy_94 is a 15-min equity strategy on Nifty50 stocks with VWAP z-score -2.7, rel_volume > 1.2, and VIX > 15 filter. Key adaptations: (1) Universe changed from Nifty50 stock basket to NIFTY index itself — VWAP reversion on the index has cleaner institutional mechanics than individual stocks; (2) Timeframe: 15-min bars → 5-second bars; STDDEV lookback changed from 14 bars × 15 min (3.5 hours) to 240 bars × 5s (20 min) — current regime rather than multi-hour context; (3) rel_volume baseline changed from SMA(30) on 15-min (450-min multi-session) to 4-min rolling mean (48 bars at 5s) — session-relative, not multi-session; (4) VIX > 15 threshold kept at same level (structural threshold independent of bar frequency); (5) Volume threshold 1.2x kept from original — this is the key differentiator vs v3 (1.7x), made possible by the VIX regime gate doing the quality filtering; (6) ATR-based stops replaced with fixed 5-pt option premium stop (5/9 R:R vs v3's 7/12) reflecting the more frequent but smaller-bounce nature of VIX-gated entries vs pure panic events.
weaknesses: VIX > 15 filter significantly reduces opportunity set on calm sessions — may produce 0 signals on low-VIX days
z=-2.7 events in VIX > 15 environments can sometimes be the START of a structural breakdown (not a reversion), especially on macro shock days
20-min rolling std can be artificially low in first 20 minutes, inflating z-scores near open — session filter mitigates this
On high-VIX expiry days, option gamma effects may create VWAP dislocations that don't revert as institutional hedging flows dominate
